Name: (AT) Soren's Bunny-Approved Furniture
Author: nordkyst
Description:
As someone who had an indoor rabbit that my partner and I spoiled rotten, I often felt like my rabbits were probably sad in the coop. I made this set of furniture to decorate both your farmhouse & your bunnies' coop!
[center]
[size=4][u][b]Textures Included:[/b][/u][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][size=2][Decorative Bowl] - bunny beds, netherland dwarf rabbits facing away, various greens in bowls, stacking cups, and a chew toy.[/size]
[*][size=2][Large Futan Bear] - A variety of rabbits climbing on stuff they shouldn't and getting into things :/[/size]
[*][size=2][Red Cottage Rug] - An assortment of rugs with varying degrees of rabbit-related mess.[/size]
[*][Jade Hills] -- 4 bunny paintings
[/list]
[center]﻿PS - all the colors in this are meant to match well with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26580]Botanical Wallpapers[/url]﻿ mod :)[/center]
[center][b][size=4][u]Acknowledgement[/u][/size][/b][/center]
This mod was partially made [b]in memory of Pan[/b], a 2.5 lb netherland dwarf mix who was my partner's rabbit and became my rabbit too. Every stranger was his best friend, from plumbers and contractors to small children. He outlived every other rabbit in his litter by years and years. Thanks for reading this, if you did - if you have a rabbit please give them a kiss and a treat for me :)
